quote: Not trading is also a trade.
No setup, no trade. That is the job.
A quiet day is part of the plan.
Waiting for the right setup is a skill.
Some days the best trade is the one you skip.
Discipline looks boring from the outside.
Cash is a position. Today we held it.
No edge today, so no risk today.
Doing nothing on purpose is still doing the work.
Most bad trades start with not wanting to wait.
Activity is not progress. Patience is part of the method.
Missing a move costs nothing. Forcing one can cost a lot.
Today the plan said wait. So we waited.
Patience is a position, not a pause.
Good traders are selective, not busy.
The market is open every day. The setup is not.
Sitting out is a decision, not a mistake.
